scope: P2-45 ramp-tip ground-clearance sweep to basket entrance; no retention, multi-ball or launch claim

ramp_height_rule.rationale: Raises and blends the tangent tongue without creating a downward step; the basket end and frozen chassis/module geometry remain unchanged.

success_definition.collection_success: ball fully crosses the nip and its centre enters the 96 mm basket mouth
success_definition.plough_policy: reported as path information; it does not override a successful capture in P2-45

criteria.name: condition_success_count
criteria.rationale: The user explicitly requested basket entrance 5/5 for this reduced height sweep.

criteria.name: basket_entry_reached
criteria.comparison: ball centre crosses base-frame entrance volume
criteria.rationale: Same physical 96 mm central basket opening as corrected P2-44 r2.

criteria.name: fully_through_nip
criteria.rationale: Separates capture from downstream ramp failure.

criteria.name: d5065_current
criteria.rationale: Existing provisional analytical-model gate; spin-up and contact windows are reported separately.

criteria.name: d5065_torque
criteria.rationale: 20 A times frozen Kt=0.031 N m/A.

criteria.name: forbidden_launcher_contact_count
criteria.rationale: Any launcher-to-ramp/chassis/ground contact invalidates the height candidate.

criteria.name: plough
criteria.rationale: P2-45 explicitly separates successful collection from forward/lateral push path diagnostics.
